blocks.translation:
• Confirm the power switch is set to OFF.
• Remove the battery cover, then use a + or − screwdriver to remove the battery lid and insert three AAA (R03) batteries with the correct polarity.
• Move the power switch toward O (ON); the unit will start up and play the “Geartringer” voice line.
• If you hold the trigger while turning the power ON at startup, the unit enters "Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger Memorial Mode." See the voice list on pages 12–15.

△ 注意 お買い上げのお客様へ 必ずお読みください。
●本商品の対象年齢は15才以上です。 対象年齢未満のお子様には絶対に与えないでください。
●小さな部品、電池がありますので、小さなお子様が誤って飲み込まないように注意してください。 窒息などの危険があります。
●耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、 聴覚を損なう恐れがあります。
●本商品には電子部品を使用しております。 ペースメーカーをご使用の方は、本商品を身体に近づけないようご注意ください。

●二次電池 (充電式電池) は、 絶対に使用しないでください。
●古い電池と新しい電池、いろいろな種類の電池をまぜて使わないでください。

blocks.translation:
• Warning: To customers who purchased this product — read this information completely.
• This product is for ages 15 and older. Do not give it to children younger than the indicated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries. Keep it away from small children to prevent accidental swallowing, which can cause choking.
• Do not use this product near the ears. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, do not bring this product close to your body.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause nausea or other adverse effects.
• If you use batteries incorrectly they may overheat, rupture, or leak. Observe the following precautions.
• Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct + and − polarity.

●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を加えたり、落としたりすると破損する恐れがあります。 本商品は精密な電子部品で
構成されています。 落としたり、水に濡らしたり、 汚したり、分解したりしないでください。 また、高温・低温になるところでの使用、
保管はさけてください。プラスチック梱包材は、 開封後はすぐに捨ててください。 ●本商品には塗装部分がありますので、保管の

blocks.translation:
• This product is precisely made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains delicate electronic parts. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very hot or very cold places. Dispose of the plastic packing material immediately after opening.
• This product has painted surfaces. When storing it, avoid contact with other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas), as the color may transfer.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable parts or attachment parts in unnatural directions.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or may be hard to hear due to the product's characteristics.
• Do not attach anything other than Sentai Gear or Abataro Gear to this product. Doing so may cause malfunction or breakage.

マジーヌ、ブルーンのメモリアルモードで変身すると、みんなが
メンバーに加入したカイの変身も再現できちゃうチュン!?
blocks.translation:
• Aaaah—! This is it!! To the BGM of “All Five Together, Zenkaiger!”, all five Zenkaigers can transform together at once, chun!
• Also, if you transform in the Memorial Mode for Juram, Gaon, Magine, or Blueon, you can also recreate Kai’s transformation when each of them joined the team, chun!?

ガオーン、マジーヌ、

ゼンカイジャー最終決戦モードでは

blocks.translation:
• Press and hold the BGM button.
• The "start line" shown in the table below will play, then the BGM will start automatically.
• The BGM will loop for a fixed period.
• In Kaito, Juran, Gaon, Majinu, and Bruun modes the BGM is "5-nin sorotte ZenkaiJā! (first half)"; in ZenkaiJā final-battle mode the "sound of the gears lighting up" plays.

japanese_items: ◎ 5人揃って!ゼンカイジャー変身遊び (名乗り / BGM付き変身)
※介人モードを例に説明します。
※どのギアを使用しても、 同じ音声が鳴ります。

ただし、読み込み後は、読み込んだギアに応じた
挙動になります。

※マスターモード、ステイシー入れ替わりモードでは
遊べません。
ア"ア"ア"ー! これは〜ッ!!「5人揃ってゼンカイジャー!」のBGMにあわせて、ゼンカイジャーの5人みんなで一緒に変身できちゃうチュン!
さらに、ジュラン、ガオーン、マジーヌ、ブルーンのメモリアルモードで変身すると、みんながメンバーに加入したカイの変身も再現できちゃうチュン!?
BGMボタンを長押しします。
→下記の表の「開始セリフ」が鳴ります。その後、BGMが自動で再生開始します。
BGMは一定時間ループします。
※BGMは、介人、ジュラン、ガオーン、マジーヌ、ブルーンモードでは「5人揃ってゼンカイジャー!(前半)」、ゼンカイジャー最終決戦モードでは「ギアが光る音」が鳴ります。
BGMが再生している間に、カバーを開けて、変身したいゼンカイジャーのギアを表面で入れ、カバーを閉じます。
「カバー開け音」、「カバー閉じ音」が鳴ります。
カバーを閉じた直後にトリガーを押します。
通常モードなら「ギアトリンガーを構える音」、メモリアルモードならキャラクターの「チェンジ全開!」が鳴ります。
読み込みの手順は 「変身遊び」 と同じです。
下記の表の「変身音+名乗り音声」が鳴ります。その後、BGMが自動で再生開始します。
※BGMは、介人、ジュラン、ガオーン、マジーヌ、ブルーンモードでは「5人揃ってゼンカイジャー! (後半)」、ゼンカイジャー最終決戦モードでは「見よ!!ゼンカイジャー」が鳴ります。
各モードごとに違う音声が鳴ります。
詳しくは下記の表を参照してください。
※BGMボタンを短押ししてBGMを止めると、この遊びから抜けます。
5人の変身音
介人「いくぞ!」
ジュラン「おうよ!」
5人の変身音、名乗り
5人 「5人合わせて!機界戦隊ゼンカイジャー!」
セッちゃん 「ヤッター!遂に揃ったチュン!」
介人 「行くぜ! ゼンリョク、ゼンカーイ!ちょあー!」
介人「行くぜ!」
5人「ゼンリョク、ゼンカーイ!」

Reading of the character name ジュラン is given in katakana as "Juran"; alternative romanizations may exist.
Reading of the name 介人 rendered as "Kaito"—original text gives only kanji.
Translation of ゼンリョク、ゼンカーイ as "Full power, full gear" is interpretive of shouted battle-cry phrasing.

2階の窓から飛び出して大けが!
source_blocks.translation: 1993: Entered junior high! He insisted he was going to another world, jumped out of a second-floor window, and was badly injured!

source_blocks.text:
1996年高校入学!のちのパートナー美津子と出会い
意気投合!ふたりで並行世界の研究を始める!
source_blocks.translation: Entered high school in 1996! Met Mitsuko, who would become my partner — we hit it off and began researching parallel worlds together!

source_blocks.text: それじゃあ、行ってきます。 みんなも元気でね
source_blocks.translation: Alright then, I'm off. Take care, everyone.

source_blocks.text: 全部の世界に行っちゃう戦隊だー!ちょあー!
source_blocks.translation: We're the Sentai that's going to visit every world! Choa!

• What the hell do you think you're doing!!
• What the— You won't even fight the Gorenja seniors properly,

• do you seriously think it doesn't matter what happens to us?

• (Runs out of Colorful)
• Huh—
• Ah…
• Gaon! (chases)

• Kaito is human… he's not as sturdy as we are.
• "We"…!?
• Huh?
• He said he thinks of Juran and the others as comrades!
• …Well, sort of? Like allies who protect humans, I guess. What about Stacey and the Gorenjā team,

• That's pathetic! Up until now, trash like Tojitendo was being controlled by something like that,
• and other Kikai-noids, and even ourselves,
• we hated everything! …so we could fight without holding back. It's not pathetic. I understand being torn…
• Honestly, I wondered what to do about Stacey too.

• If you think they might be human, it's a bit…
• …Also, Juran and the others are amazing!
• They steel themselves no matter who they're up against.
• And we're dithering like this, right!
• Heh… yeah!
• I'm a Kikai-noid, so…
• Am I no good? Am I really no good…?
• My heart—
• What were we doing, huh?
• How careless! We were turned into fighting bulls too!
• Ugh… everyone… good…
• Hey! Gaon!
• Gaon! Are you okay? Does it hurt?
• Kaito… thank goodness. Zenkaiju Gear came, didn't it?
• Yeah. Thanks to Gaon, we defeated it!
• What were you doing, you idiot! Don't be reckless!
• Right!
• Heh heh… sometimes I have to be on the receiving end from you guys.
• It's the price for having been cold to you all the time…
• You did that…!
• Ah…
• No, it's different. This time it was my haste and mistake…
• I'm the one at fault for deciding it was your fault.
• It's fine, Juran. You were right.
• I was childish.
• Heh heh
• Heh
• Good— we're reconciled, Zenkai!

source_blocks.text:
これじゃあゼンカイジャーにチェンジできないチュン!

source_blocks.translation:
At this rate we can't change into Zenkaiger, chun!
We're probably not the first in the world...

source_blocks.text: そうだ･･･他の世界のスーパー戦隊もきっと!

source_blocks.text: てかなんか、 新しくなっとる!

お前らトジテンドみたいなのと戦って、
世界を守ったはずなんだ!
source_blocks.translation:
You guys fought against the likes of Tojitendo...
...and you were supposed to have saved the world!

source_blocks.text: 一体、何が起こっているのですか?
そんな大事な世界をトジルギアなんかにして!
source_blocks.translation: Turning such an important world into a Tojiru Gear!

source_blocks.text: 世界侵略に利用するなんて、ハチャメチャに酷い!
source_blocks.translation: Using it for world conquest is absolutely outrageous!

source_blocks.text: そんな悪い使い方、断じて許すわけにはいきません!
source_blocks.translation: I absolutely will not permit such wicked use!

source_blocks.text:
そっかトジルギアにされた、 スーパー戦隊の
世界が・・・ 力を貸してくれたんだ
はっは、閉じ込められてるってのに
パイセンたち流石だわ
source_blocks.translation:
I see... the Super Sentai worlds that were turned into Tojiru Gears lent us their power.
Haha — even though they're trapped, those veterans are amazing.

百獣パワー、ゼンカイガオーン!
魔法パワー、ゼンカイマジーヌ!
轟轟パワー、ゼンカイブルーン!

source_blocks.translation:
Even if we can't Change... we'll go all-out until we get results!
Secret Power, Zenkaiser!
Dinosaur Power, Zenkai Juran!
Beast Power, Zenkai Gaon!
Magic Power, Zenkai Magine!
Roaring Power, Zenkai Vroon!
All five together: Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger!

source_blocks.text:
ここまでされたら･･･もう絶対負けない!
うん!おうよ!はい!
source_blocks.translation:
After all this... I absolutely won't lose!
Yeah! You bet! Right!

source_blocks.text:
お前を倒して、全部の世界を解放する!

行くぜ!
source_blocks.translation:
I'll defeat you and free every world!
(Gear insertion sound → "Change Zenkai!" — transformation voice)
Let's go!

blocks.text: 順番 キャラクター
機界戦隊ゼンカイジャー!

キャラクター
介人

俺は、世界初の･･･何かでっっかいことがしたいんだ!
決めた!・・・俺は世界を守る! 結果出すまで、全力全開だー!
blocks.translation:
I want to do something huge—the world's first of its kind!
That's it! I'll protect the world! I'll go all-out until I get results!

blocks.text:
ジュラン
ガオーン

よーし、いくぞ!
おうよ!
blocks.translation:
Alright, let's go!
You got it!

blocks.text: (キュピーン) ピッガガーピーガガ・・・
チュッチュッチュつ、チューニング完了っ!
ねぇ。俺と一緒にトジテンドと戦ってよ
blocks.translation: Hey, come fight Tojitendo with me.

blocks.text:
イェイ!ゼンカイ!×2
ハッ!

はぁ!?あ、いや、ちょ、ちょまてよ。俺もキカイノイドだぜ?
ぶっちゃけよく初対面でそんなこと俺に...
blocks.translation:
Huh!? Ah, no—wait, woah, hold on. I'm a Kikainoid too, you know?
Honestly, it's a lot to say something like that to me on our first meeting...

blocks.text: 俺もおじさんと仲良くしたい。
blocks.translation: I want to get along with you too, mister.

blocks.text: だって・・・あいつらとは違うじゃん
blocks.translation: I mean... I'm different from them, aren't I?

blocks.text: フン!ああそうだ。あいつらとは違う!
blocks.translation: Hmph! Yeah, that's right. I'm different from them!

blocks.text: おじさんじゃねぇ、 ジュランだ。 ヨロシコ
blocks.translation: Don't call me an old man—I'm Juran. Yoroshiko

blocks.text:
介人
ジュラン
ガオーン
3人
俺は介人。 五色田介人、よろしく!
blocks.translation: I'm Kaito. Goshikida Kaito — nice to meet you!

blocks.text:
<ゼンカイザー、ゼンカイジュラン、
ゼンカイガオーン変身音>
秘密のパワー、ゼンカイザー!

百獣パワー、ゼンカイガオーン!
3人合わせて、機界戦隊ゼンカイジャー!
blocks.translation:
<Zenkaiser, Zenkai Juran, Zenkai Gaon transformation sounds>
Secret Power, Zenkaiser!
Dinosaur Power, Zenkai Juran!
Beast Power, Zenkai Gaon!
Together, the three of us: Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger!

blocks.text: よっしゃあ! 俺決まってんな、 今の
blocks.translation: Yeah! I nailed that just now.

blocks.text: 機界変形ジュランティラノ!
機界変形ガオーンライオン!

blocks.translation: I told you not to get in the way.

blocks.text: なめこのせいにすんじゃねえよ
blocks.translation: Don't blame it on the Nameko.

blocks.text:
お、なんだなんだ、 おいなんか聞こえるぞ。
おいおい・・・あ、ここか!
blocks.translation:
Oh, what's this, what's this? Hey, I can hear something.
Hey—oh, is it over here!

blocks.text:
ジュラン
ガオーン
秘密のパワー、ゼンカイザー!
恐竜パワー、ゼンカイジュラン!

介人/ジュラン
セッちゃん
介人
2人合わせて、機界戦隊ゼンカイジャー!
blocks.translation: The two of us together—Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger!

blocks.text: ヤッターーー!最高!イェーーー!
blocks.translation: Yay! This is the best! Yeah!

blocks.text:
あー今はけんかしている場合じゃないって
あ一介人! 介人のギアは···
<ビーッグバーン!ゼンカーイガッターイ!>
接吻からの) なにやってんだよ、お前
気持ち悪い
blocks.translation:
Ah—now's not the time to be fighting.
Ah—Kaito! Kaito's Gear is...
<Big Bang! Zenkai Gattai!>
(after the kiss) What the hell are you doing, man?
That's gross.

blocks.text:
→ゼンカイオージュラガオーン合体音
え?え?なんだこれ!
合体した!すげえ!こんなの世界初じゃん!
blocks.translation:
→ Zenkai-Oh JuraGaon combination sound
Huh? Huh? What is this?!
It combined! Amazing! This is a world first!

blocks.text: ジュラン、ギアを裏返して使うチュン!
blocks.translation: Juran, flip the Gear over and use it, chun!

blocks.text:
初じゃないチュン。 でも仲間の力を
合わせて戦えるチュン!
blocks.translation: It's not the first time, chun. But we can combine our friends' powers and fight, chun!

blocks.text: おっ・・・わかった!えっと･･･ 裏返して、こうか
blocks.translation: Oh... I get it! Um... flip it over, like this?

blocks.text: だってさ!聞いてる?ジュラン、ガオーン。
blocks.translation: Hey! Are you listening? Juran, Gaon.

blocks.text: ぐるぐるぐる、さあいくぜーー!はー!
blocks.translation: Round and round, now let's go—haa!
The three of us will join forces!

blocks.text:
いやいやいや、やばいやばいやばい!
→ゼンカイジュラン巨大化音
blocks.translation:
No, no, no—this is bad, bad, bad!
→ Zenkai Juran giantization sound

blocks.text: はぁ!? 何人が好きなもん馬鹿にして
blocks.translation: Huh!? Don't make fun of the things I like!

blocks.text: すっげぇ!ジュランもデカさゼンカイだー
blocks.translation: Awesome! Juran's gone full Zenkai-size too!

blocks.text:
くれてんの?知らないくせに雑に否定すんな!
氷河期って・・・ なんだ!?
介人さんの仲間になってみたい。 でも、怖い。
ヌヌヌマジーヌヌヌヌマジーヌ。は･･･!
blocks.translation:
You're giving it to me? Don't casually dismiss it when you don't even know!
"Ice Age"... what is that!?
I want to try becoming Kaito-san's ally. But I'm scared.
Nununu-Magine, nununu-Magine. Huh...!

blocks.text: ああ、お前なんで(言葉をさえぎられる)…うう...

マジーヌ
介ジュガ
すすす… そんなことさせない!
blocks.translation: I... I won't let you do that!

blocks.text: 介人、大丈夫かい?ごめんね、
blocks.translation: Kaito, are you okay? I'm sorry,

blocks.text: せっかく開けそうな新しい世界、
blocks.translation: A new world that's finally within reach—

blocks.text: 僕がもっと早く決意していれば・・・
blocks.translation: If only I had made up my mind sooner...
I won't let myself be crushed!

blocks.text: 僕も、ゼンカイジャーになるよ。
blocks.translation: I'm going to become a Zenkaiger too.

blocks.text: 介人さん、自分も入れていい?
blocks.translation: Kaito-san, can I join in too?

blocks.text: お前さっきは嫌だって・・・ (無視される)･･･またですか･･･
blocks.translation: You said you didn't want to earlier... (ignored) ...Here we go again...

blocks.text:
許せないんだ、この世界のかわいい生き物たちを
苦しめるやつを。この僕をこんな体にしたやつを!
トジテンド!僕とかわいい生き物たちの苦しみ、
100倍にして思い知らせてやる!
blocks.translation: I won't forgive those who torment the cute creatures of this world—or the ones who turned me into a body like this! Tojitendo! I'll make you realize our suffering a hundredfold!

blocks.text: うん、もちろん。 よろこんで!
blocks.translation: Yeah, of course. I'd be happy to!

blocks.text: ありがとう、ガオーン。 一緒に戦おう!
blocks.translation: Thank you, Gaon. Let's fight together!

source_blocks.translation: I'm going to become a Zenkaiger too.

source_blocks.text: 介人さん、自分も入れていい?

source_blocks.text:
許せないんだ、この世界のかわいい生き物たちを
苦しめるやつを。この僕をこんな体にしたやつを!

100倍にして思い知らせてやる!
source_blocks.translation: I won't forgive those who torment the cute creatures of this world—or the ones who turned me into a body like this! Tojitendo! I'll make you realize our suffering a hundredfold!

source_blocks.text: うん、もちろん。 よろこんで!
source_blocks.translation: Yeah, of course. I'd be happy to!

source_blocks.text: ありがとう、ガオーン。 一緒に戦おう!
source_blocks.translation: Thank you, Gaon. Let's fight together!

マジーヌ!
source_blocks.translation:
Alright! We'll speed up to make up for lost time!
Some things just can't be done—ahhh!
Magine!

source_blocks.text:

トジテンドに対する反乱分子ですか? どうしてギアを使って

それとも皆さんも世界をギアに閉じ込めたんですか?教えて
ください、もう好奇心のエンジンがブルンブルンなのです!
俺は介人。君は?
source_blocks.translation:
Excuse me! So you are the Zenkaigers.
Are you rebels against Tojitendo? Why are you using Gears?
Did you steal them from Lord Ijirude, perhaps?
Or did you also lock worlds away inside Gears? Please tell me —
the engine of my curiosity is revving like crazy!
I'm Kaito. And you?

source_blocks.text: マジーヌ! 片づけられないあなたが
source_blocks.translation: Magine! You're the one who can't tidy up.

source_blocks.text:

ブルーン

マジーヌ

どうして一瞬で私を探しあてられたの
ですか、占いですか?
ゴミの山からもの探すの、慣れてるんで!
あ、そういう...
ブルーン、掃除の続き、 自分も手伝ってもよ?
すみませんでした、よろしくお願いします!
こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします!
一緒に頑張りましょう!
source_blocks.translation:
How did you find me so instantly? Was it fortune-telling?
I'm used to searching for things in piles of trash!
Oh, I see...
Bruun, can I help with the rest of the cleaning?
I'm sorry. Thank you very much!
Likewise — nice to meet you!
Let's do our best together!

source_blocks.text:
イジルデ様、いえ、イジルデ!あなたは私に、何も教えてくれません
でした。でも私は今日学びました。 これまで私が、 どんなに狭い
世界にいたかということを。知ることで世界は広がるということを。
お別れに、私が教えてあげます。私の名前はブルーンです!
source_blocks.translation: Ijirude-sama — no, Ijirude! You never taught me anything. But today I learned how narrow the world I had been living in truly was, and that learning can broaden the world. As a farewell, I will tell you: my name is Bloon!

source_blocks.text: お前、どういうつもりだ!!
source_blocks.translation: What do you think you're doing?!

source_blocks.text:
ガオーン
ジュラン

介人さん、私も一緒に戦わせてください。 私はこの世界で、
あなたのもとで、 もっと学びたくなったのです
ありがとう、ブルーン。一緒に戦おう。これ
source_blocks.translation: Kaito-san, please let me fight alongside you. I want to learn more in this world, and to learn under you. Thank you, Bloon. Let's fight together.

source_blocks.text: はい!すいません、使い方をおしえてください
source_blocks.translation: Yes! Excuse me, could you please tell me how to use it?

source_blocks.translation:
Secret Power, Zenkaiser!
Dinosaur Power, Zenkai Juran!
Beast Power, Zenkai Gaon!
Magic Power, Zenkai Magine!
Roaring Power, Zenkai Bloon!
All five together — Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger!
Yay! Finally, we're all together—cchun!
Let's go! Full-power Zenkai! Choaa!

source_blocks.text: 俺の事。 いつもかばってくれて、ありがとな
source_blocks.translation: About me... thanks for always protecting me.

source_blocks.text: ・・・僕たちほど、頑丈じゃないし
source_blocks.translation: ...They aren't as tough as us, after all.

source_blocks.text:
ジュラン達のこと、仲間だと
思ってくれてるんだって!
・・・まあ、一応? 人間たちを守る、 同志かなあとは
ステイシーやゴレンジャーたちのことも、
人間だったらどうしようって、なった?
情けないよねえ!今までは、 トジテンド
みたいなクズも、あんなのに支配されてる
他のキカイノイドも、 自分のこともぜ〜んぶ
嫌いで!･･･遠慮なく、 戦えたのに
source_blocks.translation:
Apparently, they actually consider Juran and the others to be allies!
...Well, I suppose so? Comrades in protecting humanity, maybe.
Did you also find yourself wondering—"What if Stacy or the Gorengers were human?"
It's pathetic, isn't it? Up until now, I hated everything—scum like Tojitendo, the other Kikai-noids ruled by them, and even myself! ...That's why I could fight them without holding back.

source_blocks.text: ブルーン・マジーヌ ああ···

ゴレンジャーパイセンたちとはまともに
戦わねえ、ステイシーはかばう!人間さえ
守れりゃ、マジで俺たちはどうなっても
いいってか?俺たちは一緒に戦う仲間だろ!!
でも君たちは キカイノイドだろ!!
source_blocks.translation: You won't seriously fight the Gorenger veterans, but you'll protect Stacy! So, as long as you can protect humans, you seriously don't care what happens to us? We're supposed to be allies fighting together! But you guys are Kikainoids, aren't you!

blocks.text: セリフリスト:機界戦隊ゼンカイジャーメモリアルモード
blocks.translation: Dialogue List: Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger Memorial Mode

blocks.text: 順番 キャラクター

情けなくないよ。迷うの、 わかるし・・・。
正直俺も、ステイシーのことどうしたらいいかなって
介人も?
人間かもって思ったら、ちょっとね。
・・・ってか、 ジュラン達がすごいんだよな!
誰相手でも覚悟決めててさ。俺たちこんな迷ってるのに。 な!
フフッ・・・うん!
blocks.translation:
• That's not pathetic. I understand being unsure...
• Honestly, I'm not sure what to do about Stacy either.
• Kaito too?
• If you think she might be human, it complicates things a bit.
• But Juran and the others are amazing!
• They're ready to go all in against anyone. Meanwhile we're hesitating like this, right?
• Heh... yeah!

blocks.text:
ごめんね、みんな・・・。 ここで待ってて。
自分、 トジテンドを倒しにいかなきゃだから...
blocks.translation:
• I'm sorry, everyone... Wait here.
• I have to go and defeat Tojitend...

blocks.text:
ああーーんにゃろー、マージマジで怒り倒したるわあああ!!
わあああ…マジーヌー!
え!･･･マジで怖い!
blocks.translation:
• Aaa— you son of a—! I'm seriously, seriously going to beat you down!!
• Waaa... "Majinu"!
• What!... That's really scary!

blocks.text:
僕は、キカイノイドなんで・・・
俺じゃダメか? 俺じゃ、ダメなのか･･･?
キュンです・・・
blocks.translation:
• Because I'm an android...
• Am I no good? Is it really no good with me...?
• My heart skips...

blocks.text:
なんでしょう･･･ この、 これまでに感じたことのない、 幸せは!
私は…私はもう･･･ 恋のエンジンがブルンブルンブルン!!
blocks.translation:
• What is this... this happiness I've never felt before!
• I... I'm already... my love engine is revving, revving, revving!!

blocks.text:
レンアイワルドは倒したのに、
なんだか少し胸に苦しいものが残りますね...
ブルーンよ、それはきっと偽物じゃなくて、
お前の本当の気持ちなんじゃねえの?
なんと!
・・・なるほど。 これが、恋でしたか...
blocks.translation:
• Even though we defeated Renaiwald,
• I still feel a little ache in my chest...
• Bruun, that's surely not a fake,
• isn't it your true feeling?
• What!
• …I see. So this was love...

blocks.text:
スーパーチェンジ全開!→スーパーゼンカイザー変身音
秘密のパワーアップ!スーパーゼンカイザー!
blocks.translation:
• Full Super Change! → Super Zenkai-zer transformation sound
• Secret power-up! Super Zenkai-zer!

blocks.text:
なにやってた、俺たち?
不覚!私たちも、闘牛にされていたとは!
ぐ･･･みんな･･･よか...った…..
おい!ガオーン!
ガオーン!大丈夫?痛くない?
blocks.translation:
• What were we doing?
• How careless! We were turned into fighting bulls too!
• Ugh... everyone... thank goodness...
• Hey! Gaoon!
• Gaoon! Are you okay? Does it hurt?

blocks.text:
介人･･･よかった。 ゼンカイジュウギア、 来てくれたんだね
うん。ガオーンのおかげで、倒せたよ!
つかなにやってんだお前!無茶しやがって!
そうですよ!
ふふふ･･･ 僕もたまには、君たちにやられる側にならないとね。
ずーっと君たちに、冷たくしてきた、ツケさ...
そんなことを･･･!
ああ･･･
blocks.translation:
• Kaito... I'm relieved. Zenkai Juugia, you came, huh.
• Yeah. I was able to take it down thanks to Gaon!
• Hey, what are you doing?! That was reckless!
• Exactly!
• Heh... Every so often I should be the one getting beaten by you guys.
• It's the price for having been cold to you for so long...
• How could you...!
• Ah...

blocks.text:
あ~違うんだ。 今回は俺のはやとちりだ...
お前のせいって決めつけちまった俺が悪い
いいんだジュラン。 君の言う通りだった。
僕が子供だったんだよ
へっへ
ふふ
よかった~ 仲直りゼンカイ!
blocks.translation:
• Ah— that's not it. This time I jumped to conclusions.
• It's my fault for deciding it was your fault.
• It's all right, Juran. You were right.
• I was the childish one.
• Heh heh
• Heh
• I'm glad—we're reconciled, Zenkai!

blocks.text:
イケてるおにーさん、よかったらお食事ご一緒しませんか
ジュラン
blocks.translation:
• Hey, good-looking guy—if you'd like, would you have a meal with me?
• Juran

blocks.text:
介人、お前が気になってんなら、ステイシーに聞いた方が
いいんじゃねえか。 介人を倒すっていうことはヤツデを悲しませる
ことになる。お前と同じ目になるんだぞって。いやもちろん、
介人が負けるって言ってるわけじゃねーんだけどさ
俺からは言えないよ。俺に言われんのが一番いやだと思うし
なんかずるいし。 それに、ステイシーが一番よくわかってると
思う。あいつ、全部わかってて覚悟決めてきたんだ
そっか
おやじ、水
blocks.translation:
• Kaito, if you're worried about it, you should ask Stacy.
• Telling her you plan to defeat Kaito will just make Yatsude sad. It’ll put her in the same situation you were in.
• Not that I’m saying Kaito will lose, of course.
• I can’t say it myself. I think he’d hate hearing it from me most of all, and it would feel unfair.
• Besides, I think Stacy understands best. She knew everything and came prepared.
• I see.
• Dad, water.

blocks.text:
介人、俺と合体しろ!いつも俺がガオーンと
やってるみてえに!
よし・・・やってみよう!ジュラン!
blocks.translation:
• Kaito, fuse with me! Like when I always go "Gaoon"!
• All right... let's give it a try! Juran!

blocks.text:
よっしゃいくぜ!
うん!よろしこゼンカイ!
スーパーゼンカイオージュラン!
|介人、今俺らは一心同体だ!思い切り戦え!
ありがとう!
blocks.translation:
• All right, let's go!
• Yeah! Let's do this, Zenkai!
• Super Zenkai O-Juran!
• Kaito, right now we are one body and mind! Fight with everything you've got!
• Thank you!

blocks.text:
なんと･･･5人みんなで合体できるっチュン!
えー!!
合体コードは、 全力全開合体チュン!
blocks.translation:
• What... all five of us can combine, chun!
• Whaat!!
• Combination code: "Full-Power Full-Throttle Combine, chun!"

blocks.text:
よーし
全力全開合体!
blocks.translation:
• All right!
• Full power, full throttle—combine!

blocks.text:
介人、最後って
→<掛け合い付きゼンリョクゼンカイオー合体音>
あのさ、とーちゃんのことなんだけど。
次で最後にしようと思って
次が、 とーちゃん取り戻す最後のチャレンジ。
全力全開の一回に賭ける
もしそれでダメなら、ハカイジュウオーをどっか、
宇宙の果てとか、世界の狭間とかに
連れていけないかなって
blocks.translation:
• →<Combined transformation sound with dialogue: Zenryoku Zenkai-O>
• Hey, it's about Dad.
• I'm thinking the next time will be the last one.
• Kaito, when I say last,
• the next time will be the final challenge to get Dad back.
• I'm going to bet everything on one full-power attempt.
• If that doesn't work, maybe we could take Hakai Ju-o somewhere—
• like to the edge of space or to some gap between worlds— and leave him there.

blocks.text:
もしもなんてあるかよ!介人、 お前がもしもの
事なんて考えんな!つーか、
お前があきらめたって俺はあきらめねーぞ

みんな･･･

• Besides, even if you give up, I'm not giving up!
• Right! And hey, Kaito, Yacchan and Secchan—don't go making that decision among the three of you on your own. Kaito's family is definitely family to us too.
• If this is 'the last time,' it means we'll make sure to take it back next time.
• Everyone...

1980年5月30日、 五色田功、誕生!
1984年幼稚園入園!お昼寝の時間に全く
寝ないで絵本を読み漁り、 先生を困らせる!
1987年、小学校入学! 絵本で見た本物の

blocks.translation:
Zenkaiger — Full-Power Destruction!
May 30, 1980: Isao Goshikida is born!
1984: Enters kindergarten! He wouldn't sleep at nap time and read picture books nonstop, troubling his teachers!
1987: Enters elementary school! Desperate to go to the real world he saw in picture books, he began studying intensely!
1993: Enters junior high! He insisted he would go to another world, jumped out of a second‑floor window, and was badly injured!
1996: Enters high school! He met his future partner Mitsuko and immediately hit it off! Together they began researching parallel worlds!

source_blocks.text: セリフリスト:機界戦隊ゼンカイジャーメモリアルモード
source_blocks.translation: Dialogue List: Kikai Sentai Zenkaiger Memorial Mode

source_blocks.text: 順番 キャラクター
情けなくないよ。迷うの、 わかるし・・・。
source_blocks.translation: That's not pathetic. I understand being unsure...

source_blocks.text: 介人、俺と合体しろ!いつも俺がガオーンと
source_blocks.translation: Kaito, combine with me! Like I'm always the one who goes "Gaon"!

source_blocks.text:
正直俺も、ステイシーのことどうしたらいいかなって
介人も?
source_blocks.translation: To be honest, I've been wondering what to do about Stacy, too. You as well, Kaito?
Like I'm the one doing it!

source_blocks.text:
人間かもって思ったら、ちょっとね。
・・・ってか、 ジュラン達がすごいんだよな!
source_blocks.translation: If you think they might be human, it makes you hesitate a bit... That said, Juran and the others are amazing!

source_blocks.text: よし・・・やってみよう!ジュラン!
source_blocks.translation: Alright... let's give it a try! Juran!

source_blocks.text:
誰相手でも覚悟決めててさ。俺たちこんな迷ってるのに。 な!
フフッ・・・うん!
source_blocks.translation: They're prepared to face anyone. Meanwhile we're hesitating like this. Right? Heh... yeah!

source_blocks.text: ごめんね、みんな・・・。 ここで待ってて。
自分、 トジテンドを倒しにいかなきゃだから...
source_blocks.translation: I have to go and defeat Tojitendo...

source_blocks.text:
ああーーんにゃろー、マージマジで怒り倒したるわあああ!!
わあああ…マジーヌー!
source_blocks.translation: Aaaagh—you bastard! I'm seriously gonna beat you senseless! Waaah... Magine!

source_blocks.text:
うん!よろしこゼンカイ!
スーパーゼンカイオージュラン!
|介人、今俺らは一心同体だ!思い切り戦え!
ありがとう!
source_blocks.translation:
Yeah! Alright, Zenkai!
Super Zenkai-Oh Juran!
Kaito, we're of one mind now — fight with everything you've got!
Thank you!

source_blocks.text:
なんと･･･5人みんなで合体できるっチュン!
えー!!
source_blocks.translation:
No way... all five of us can combine, chun!
Eeeh!!

source_blocks.text: 僕は、キカイノイドなんで・・・
合体コードは、 全力全開合体チュン!
source_blocks.translation: Combination code: Full-Power Full-Throttle Combination — chun!

source_blocks.text: 俺じゃダメか? 俺じゃ、ダメなのか･･･?
source_blocks.translation: Am I no good? Am I really no good...?
My heart just skipped a beat...

source_blocks.text: なんでしょう･･･ この、 これまでに感じたことのない、 幸せは!
source_blocks.translation: What is this... this happiness I've never felt before!

source_blocks.text: 私は…私はもう･･･ 恋のエンジンがブルンブルンブルン!!
source_blocks.translation: I... I just... the engine of love is revving—vroom vroom vroom!

source_blocks.text: レンアイワルドは倒したのに、
なんだか少し胸に苦しいものが残りますね...
source_blocks.translation: it somehow leaves a little painful feeling in my chest...

source_blocks.text: ブルーンよ、それはきっと偽物じゃなくて、
source_blocks.translation: Bloon, that's surely not a fake—
Kaito, what do you mean by "the last one"?

source_blocks.text: お前の本当の気持ちなんじゃねえの?
source_blocks.translation: Isn't that how you really feel?

source_blocks.text:
→<掛け合い付きゼンリョクゼンカイオー合体音>
あのさ、とーちゃんのことなんだけど。
次で最後にしようと思って
source_blocks.translation:
→ <Zenryoku Zenkai-Oh combination sound with exchange>
Hey, about Dad... I'm thinking I'll make next time the last.

source_blocks.text:
次が、 とーちゃん取り戻す最後のチャレンジ。
全力全開の一回に賭ける
source_blocks.translation: The next attempt is the final challenge to get Dad back. I'm betting everything on this one all-out try.

source_blocks.text: ・・・なるほど。 これが、恋でしたか...

もしそれでダメなら、ハカイジュウオーをどっか、
宇宙の果てとか、世界の狭間とかに
source_blocks.translation: If that doesn't work, we'll have to send Hakaiju-oh somewhere — like the edge of the universe, or the gap between worlds.

source_blocks.text:
スーパーチェンジ全開!→スーパーゼンカイザー変身音
秘密のパワーアップ!スーパーゼンカイザー!
source_blocks.translation:
Super Change Full Throttle! → Super Zenkaiser transformation sound
Secret power-up! Super Zenkaiser!

source_blocks.text: 連れていけないかなって
source_blocks.translation: I was wondering if I could take him with me.

source_blocks.text: もしもなんてあるかよ!介人、 お前がもしもの
source_blocks.translation: There's no such thing as "what if"! Kaito, if it were you...

source_blocks.text: 不覚!私たちも、闘牛にされていたとは!
source_blocks.translation: How careless! To think we were being treated like fighting bulls too!

source_blocks.text: ガオーン!大丈夫?痛くない?
source_blocks.translation: Gaon! Are you okay? Does it hurt?

source_blocks.text: 介人･･･よかった。 ゼンカイジュウギア、 来てくれたんだね
source_blocks.translation: Kaito... I'm so glad. Zenkaiju Gear, you came.

source_blocks.text: うん。ガオーンのおかげで、倒せたよ!
source_blocks.translation: Yeah. Thanks to Gaon, we were able to defeat it!

source_blocks.text: つかなにやってんだお前!無茶しやがって!
source_blocks.translation: What the hell are you doing?! You're being reckless!

source_blocks.text: ふふふ･･･ 僕もたまには、君たちにやられる側にならないとね。
source_blocks.translation: Heh heh... I guess every once in a while I should be the one on the receiving end from you guys.

source_blocks.text: ずーっと君たちに、冷たくしてきた、ツケさ...
source_blocks.translation: It's the price I have to pay for having treated you all so coldly for so long...
To think you'd do such a thing...!

source_blocks.text:
マジーヌ
ジュラン

あ~違うんだ。 今回は俺のはやとちりだ...
お前のせいって決めつけちまった俺が悪い
source_blocks.translation: Ah—no, that's not it. This time I was just too hasty... It's my fault for deciding it was your doing.

source_blocks.text: いいんだジュラン。 君の言う通りだった。
source_blocks.translation: It's alright, Juran. You were right.

ガオーン
マジーヌ
ブルーン
介人
僕が子供だったんだよ
よかった~ 仲直りゼンカイ!
source_blocks.translation: I'm glad — we've made up, Zenkai!

source_blocks.text: イケてるおにーさん、よかったらお食事ご一緒しませんか
source_blocks.translation: Hey there, handsome—would you like to grab a bite to eat together?

source_blocks.text:
ジュラン
ガオーン
介人、お前が気になってんなら、ステイシーに聞いた方が
source_blocks.translation: Kaito, if you're curious, you'd better ask Stacey.

source_blocks.text:
いいんじゃねえか。 介人を倒すっていうことはヤツデを悲しませる
ことになる。お前と同じ目になるんだぞって。いやもちろん、
source_blocks.translation: Yeah, that's not a bad idea. Saying that defeating Kaito would make Yatsude sad — that they'd end up the same as you. I mean, of course...

source_blocks.text: 介人が負けるって言ってるわけじゃねーんだけどさ
source_blocks.translation: It's not like I'm saying Kaito is going to lose, though.

source_blocks.text:
俺からは言えないよ。俺に言われんのが一番いやだと思うし
なんかずるいし。 それに、ステイシーが一番よくわかってると
思う。あいつ、全部わかってて覚悟決めてきたんだ
source_blocks.translation: I can't be the one to say it. I think having *me* say it is the last thing she'd want—it would feel unfair, somehow. Besides, I think Stacey understands the situation better than anyone. She knew everything going in and made up her mind to do this.

source_blocks.text:
事なんて考えんな!つーか、
お前があきらめたって俺はあきらめねーぞ
そうス!つか、介人もやっちゃんもセッちゃんも、

大事な家族に決まってるじゃん
最後の一回ということなら、それは
次で必ず取り戻すという意味の一回です
みんな･･･
source_blocks.translation: Don't even think about 'what if'! I mean, even if you give up, I'm not going to give up. That's right! And hey — Kaito, Yacchan, Setchan, you three can't just decide this on your own. Kaito's family is, for us too, of course an important family. If this is supposed to be the "last time," then it's a "last time" that means we'll definitely get them back next time. Everyone...
